headlines.title: Accenture (ACN) Pushes Deeper Into AI Compliance Tools As Undervalued Narrative Builds
headlines.summary: Accenture (ACN) is pushing deeper into regulatory data platforms, using AI, cloud tools and real time risk monitoring to connect compliance feeds with enterprise risk systems and pitch more scalable, non headcount driven revenue. For all the noise around AI and regulatory data, Accenture’s share price has been under pressure in the short term, with a 7 day move down 10.26% and a 30 day share price return down 10.86%. However, the 90 day share price return is up 18.

headlines.title: Asia-Pacific Digital Transformation Market: Size, Trends, and Forecast (2026-2034) Featuring Intelligence on Accenture, Google (Alphabet), IBM, Microsoft, Oracle, HPE, SAP, EMC (Dell EMC), Cognex, Adobe and Siemens
headlines.summary: Dublin, Nov. 24, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- "Asia-Pacific Digital Transformation Market Report - Size, Trends and Forecast 2026-2034" has been added to ResearchAndMarkets.com's offering. The report projects that the Asia Pacific digital transformation market will grow from US$ 515.69 Billion in 2025 to US$ 2.86 trillion by 2034, registering a CAGR of 21% from 2026 to 2034.

headlines.title: Fortune Announces Speakers and Partners for Brainstorm AI 2026 in San Francisco Dec. 7 and 8
headlines.summary: Fortune today announced the confirmed speakers and partners for Fortune Brainstorm AI 2026, its flagship gathering on AI and business, and the dynamic forces shaping both. Under the theme "AI Eats the World," the summit takes place Dec. 7–8, 2026, at the St. Regis San Francisco.

headlines.title: Accenture vs. Palo Alto Networks: Which Tech Stock Is a Better Buy for 2027?
headlines.summary: Palo Alto trades at 84.8 times forward earnings while Accenture sits at 14.9 times, a gap that makes this choice harder than it looks.

description: Accenture plc provides consulting and managed services in the Americas, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, and the Asia Pacific. It offers artificial intelligence and data; cloud consulting; cybersecurity consulting; digital engineering and manufacturing; ecosystem partners; emerging technology; finance and risk management consulting; infrastructure and capital projects; digital learning; supply chain consulting; technology consulting; sustainability consulting; and metaverse solutions, as well as customer services. The company also provides proprietary assets and platforms, such as GenWizard, SynOps and reinvention.AI to clients. It serves aerospace and defense, automotive, banking, capital markets, chemicals, communications and media, consumer goods and services, energy, health, high tech, industrial, insurance, life sciences, natural resources, private equity, public service, retail, software and platforms, travel, and utilities industries. Accenture plc was founded in 1951 and is based in Dublin, Ireland.
